title: Kinda ugly looking
text: Kinda ugly looking. The nearly natural brand has always been a favorite of mine, this is the only piece that I haven’t liked. It just looks kind of dull and ugly....

product_metadata.title: Nearly Natural 41" Artificial Twig Branch, Brown
features: Looks great as a centerpiece for a coffee table
A single stem with multiple delicate branches
Crafted with care for a natural look
Looks identical to the real thing
description: At 41 inches tall, the delicate branches shooting off of the single stem of this artificial twig branch are sure to complement your favorite faux flower display and add a more rustic touch. Place it in a neutral-toned vase with fall colored faux flowers for a fun fall decor piece. Or, it can be positioned on your coffee table for an effortless centerpiece.
